item.title: [github_trending] denoland/celld
item.description: celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects on your own machines. Each object is its own SQLite database, replicated to a user-owned S3-compatible bucket; nodes coordinate solely through compare-and-swap on that bucket, so there's no control plane, membership protocol, or consensus. Idle cells hibernate to nearly nothing, making it an appealing option for self-hosting distributed Durable Objects.
